summary.en: The camera pulls back from a close-up of one card while its neighbours go out one by one, nearest first, until the card hangs alone and lit in the dark.
summary.zh: 从一张卡的特写缓缓后拉，周围的卡按离它的远近由近到远逐张熄灭，最后暗场中央只剩这一张发光的卡。

fits: The one number or claim the film is for; an ending that narrows to a single item.
notFor: Showing how items relate (it removes them); bright, busy films that should stay open.

intent.en: "In the end, only this one thing": everything around one card goes dark as the camera pulls away, a quiet, heavy close on the point the film is for.
intent.zh: “最后只剩这一件事”：镜头后拉、周围逐张熄灭，安静而有分量地收在全片要说的那一点上。

content.en: One hero card (a number or a claim, ≤ 24 chars, Chinese ≤ 10 characters) among 4–8 neighbour cards whose content does not matter.
content.zh: 一张主卡（一个数字或一句主张，≤ 24 字符、中文 ≤ 10 字），周围 4–8 张邻卡，内容不重要。

fits.zh: 全片为之而来的那个数字或主张；收窄到一项的结尾。

notFor.zh: 要展示几项之间的关系（它把它们删掉了）；明亮热闹、应当保持开放的片子。

pairs.note: the claim landing on the lone card

en: At the end of a film, do not follow it with an opening move such as group-photo: one closes, the other opens.
Do not stack it with another time or camera trick in the same shot.
zh: 放在片尾时，别再接 group-photo 这类“放开”的收尾：一收一放会打架。
同一镜头别再叠别的时间或运镜手法。

upstream.name: 拉远孤立
upstream.summary: 从发光主卡特写后拉，兄弟卡按距离错峰熄灭、背景沉黑，孤卡悬在暗场中央
upstream.use: 情绪节点（震撼/收束）的运镜语言；与 space-camera-moves 的"炫技大动作"互补——这两式动作小、情绪重
